Billing and payment orchestration for rent payments

A tenant enters the contract number in Payme, sees the debt and pays. The system allocates the payment to the debt, issues a fiscal receipt and shows everything in the organisation’s dashboard in real time.

  • Payme integration
  • Fiscal receipts
  • Roles and permissions
View project

INNA AI — a platform for voice and text AI agents

A 24/7 AI agent for companies, a personal AI assistant and a coaching API that analyses calls — on one multi-tenant platform.

  • AI Agent (B2B)
  • AI Persona (B2C)
  • Coaching API
View project

hubfield — an AI studio in Uzbek

Animate a photo, make a talking avatar, video, a personal song or a marketplace infographic in one place. A website and a Telegram Mini App, paid in soums.

  • Animate a photo
  • Talking avatar
  • Personal song
View project

OHMA — an engineering catalogue for transformers

Series and models, dimensional drawings, a configurator and online questionnaires on one site. A commercial offer is produced as a PDF in the browser.

Before
we begin.

How is a project priced?

We prepare a proposal after defining scope, integrations and requirements. Price and deliverables are agreed before work begins.

Can I get in touch with just an idea?

Absolutely. Our first conversation turns your idea into user needs, core features and a first delivery stage.

Can you improve an existing system?

Yes. We first review the code and architecture, then propose improvements or integrations.

How long does a project take?

Timelines depend on scope. After the brief, we agree on milestones, acceptance criteria and a delivery plan.
